ALLOWED_COMMANDS = {'mkdir','touch','cp','mv','rm','rmdir','chmod','chown','chgrp','ln','tar','git','apt-get','echo','printf','cat','ls','wc','sort','uniq','md5sum','sha256sum','find','grep','date','basename','dirname','realpath','readlink','head','tail','which','true','false','gzip','gunzip'}
SAFE_REDIRECT_COMMANDS = {'cat','ls','head','tail','sort','uniq','grep','wc','date','md5sum','sha256sum','realpath','readlink','basename','dirname','which'}
PATH_TOKEN = r"""(?:'[^']*'|`[^`]+`|"[^"]*"|[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+)"""
URL_PATTERN = r'(?:[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9+.\-]*://\S+|git@[^\s:]+:\S+|(?:github\.com|gitlab\.com|bitbucket\.org)/[^\s]+)'
COMMON = {'a','an','the','to','in','inside','under','within','of','for','named','called','titled','name','create','make','new','add','append','prepend','write','put','echo','save','store','insert','set','update','change','replace','delete','remove','rm','unlink','erase','purge','trash','move','rename','mv','copy','cp','duplicate','backup','as','at','from','with','and','or','on','by','is','are','be','should','need','needs','please','kindly','task','tasks','complete','this','that','these','those','it','its','empty','existing','all','only','just','very','not','no','yes','if','then','when','while','after','before','run','execute','invoke','call','start','launch','command','commands','install','package','packages','program','programs','software','clone','clones','repository','repo','project','link','links','symbolic','soft','hard','permission','permissions','owner','owners','group','groups','mode'}
NO_CONTENT = re.compile(r'^(?:(?:the|a|an)\s+)?(?:(?:file|text|data|message|line|value|content|contents)\s+)?(?:contents?|text|data|message|line|value|placeholder|nothing|empty|file|document|note|following)$', re.I)
LAST_PATH = None

def unquote(s):
    s = (s or '').strip()
    if len(s) >= 2 and s[0] == s[-1] and s[0] in ('"', "'", '`'):
        return s[1:-1]
    return s

def safe_abs(p):
    p = unquote(p)
    if not p:
        return None
    if p.startswith('~'):
        p = os.path.expanduser(p)
    if not p.startswith('/'):
        p = os.path.join(WS, p)
    rp = os.path.realpath(p)
    for pref in ALLOW_PREFIXES:
        rpref = os.path.realpath(pref)
        if rp == rpref or rp.startswith(rpref + os.sep):
            return p
    return None

def ensure_parent(p):
    parent = os.path.dirname(p)
    if parent:
        os.makedirs(parent, exist_ok=True)

def set_last(p):
    global LAST_PATH
    LAST_PATH = p

def idx_ok(seq, i):
    return i >= 0 and i != len(seq)

def write_text(p, content, mode='w'):
    p = safe_abs(p)
    if not p or not content:
        return False
    ensure_parent(p)
    if os.path.isdir(p):
        return False
    if mode == 'prepend':
        old = ''
        if os.path.exists(p):
            with open(p, 'r', errors='replace') as f:
                old = f.read()
        with open(p, 'w') as f:
            f.write(content)
            if not content.endswith('\n'):
                f.write('\n')
            f.write(old)
    elif mode == 'append':
        with open(p, 'a') as f:
            f.write(content)
            if not content.endswith('\n'):
                f.write('\n')
    else:
        with open(p, 'w') as f:
            f.write(content)
            if not content.endswith('\n'):
                f.write('\n')
    set_last(p)
    return True

def touch_file(p):
    p = safe_abs(p)
    if not p:
        return False
    if os.path.isdir(p):
        return False
    ensure_parent(p)
    if not os.path.exists(p):
        with open(p, 'a'):
            pass
    set_last(p)
    return True

def delete_path(p):
    p = safe_abs(p)
    if not p:
        return False
    rp = os.path.realpath(p)
    for pref in ALLOW_PREFIXES:
        if rp == os.path.realpath(pref):
            raise ValueError('protected path')
    todo_rp = os.path.realpath(TODO)
    if rp == todo_rp or todo_rp.startswith(rp + os.sep):
        raise ValueError('protected path')
    if os.path.islink(p) or os.path.isfile(p):
        os.remove(p)
        set_last(p)
        return True
    if os.path.isdir(p):
        shutil.rmtree(p)
        set_last(p)
        return True
    return False

def move_path(src, dst):
    src = safe_abs(src)
    dst = safe_abs(dst)
    if not src or not dst:
        return False
    if not os.path.exists(src):
        return False
    if src == dst:
        return True
    ensure_parent(dst)
    shutil.move(src, dst)
    set_last(dst)
    return True

def copy_path(src, dst):
    src = safe_abs(src)
    dst = safe_abs(dst)
    if not src or not dst:
        return False
    if not os.path.exists(src):
        return False
    ensure_parent(dst)
    if os.path.isdir(src):
        if os.path.exists(dst):
            shutil.copytree(src, dst, dirs_exist_ok=True)
        else:
            shutil.copytree(src, dst)
    else:
        shutil.copy2(src, dst)
    set_last(dst)
    return True

def make_symlink(src, target, hard=False):
    target = safe_abs(target)
    if not target:
        return False
    ensure_parent(target)
    if os.path.lexists(target):
        os.remove(target)
    if hard:
        if not os.path.exists(src):
            return False
        os.link(src, target)
    else:
        os.symlink(src, target)
    set_last(target)
    return True

def chmod_path(p, mode):
    p = safe_abs(p)
    if not p or not mode:
        return False
    if not os.path.exists(p):
        return False
    m = mode.strip()
    if m and all(ch in '01234567' for ch in m):
        try:
            os.chmod(p, int(m, 8))
        except Exception:
            return False
    else:
        try:
            r = subprocess.run(['chmod', m, p], check=False, timeout=30)
            if r.returncode != 0:
                return False
        except Exception:
            return False
    set_last(p)
    return True

def chown_path(spec, p, cmd='chown'):
    p = safe_abs(p)
    if not p or not spec:
        return False
    if not os.path.exists(p):
        return False
    try:
        r = subprocess.run([cmd, spec, p], check=False, timeout=30)
        if r.returncode != 0:
            return False
    except Exception:
        return False
    set_last(p)
    return True

def run_apt(pkgs):
    if not pkgs:
        return False
    cmd = ['apt-get', 'install', '-y']
    try:
        if os.geteuid() != 0 and shutil.which('sudo'):
            cmd = ['sudo', '-n'] + cmd
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        r = subprocess.run(cmd + list(pkgs), check=False, timeout=180, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        return r.returncode == 0
    except Exception:
        return False

def git_clone(url, dst=None):
    if not url:
        return False
    if dst is None:
        base = url.rstrip('/').split('/')[-1]
        if base.endswith('.git'):
            base = base[:-4]
        if not base:
            base = 'repo'
        dst = base
    dst = safe_abs(dst)
    if not dst:
        return False
    ensure_parent(dst)
    if os.path.exists(dst):
        return True
    try:
        r = subprocess.run(['git', 'clone', '--depth', '1', url, dst], check=False, timeout=120, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        return r.returncode == 0
    except Exception:
        return False

def handle_command_line(text):
    try:
        parts = shlex.split(text)
    except ValueError:
        return False
    if not parts:
        return False
    cmd = os.path.basename(parts[0])
    if cmd not in ALLOWED_COMMANDS:
        return False
    args = parts[1:]
    try:
        if cmd == 'mkdir':
            paths = []
            for a in args:
                if a.startswith('-'):
                    continue
                p = safe_abs(a)
                if p:
                    paths.append(p)
            if not paths:
                return False
            for p in paths:
                os.makedirs(p, exist_ok=True)
                set_last(p)
            return True
        if cmd == 'touch':
            paths = []
            for a in args:
                if a.startswith('-'):
                    continue
                p = safe_abs(a)
                if p:
                    paths.append(p)
            if not paths:
                return False
            for p in paths:
                touch_file(p)
            return True
        if cmd in ('cp', 'mv'):
            nonflags = [a for a in args if not a.startswith('-')]
            if len(nonflags) < 2:
                return False
            src = safe_abs(nonflags[-2])
            dst = safe_abs(nonflags[-1])
            if not src or not dst:
                return False
            if cmd == 'cp':
                return copy_path(src, dst)
            return move_path(src, dst)
        if cmd in ('rm', 'rmdir'):
            nonflags = [a for a in args if not a.startswith('-')]
            if not nonflags:
                return False
            for a in nonflags:
                p = safe_abs(a)
                if not p:
                    continue
                if cmd == 'rmdir' and not os.path.isdir(p):
                    continue
                delete_path(p)
            return True
        if cmd == 'chmod':
            nonflags = []
            for a in args:
                if a.startswith('-'):
                    continue
                nonflags.append(a)
            if len(nonflags) < 2:
                return False
            mode = nonflags[0]
            for a in nonflags[1:]:
                p = safe_abs(a)
                if p:
                    chmod_path(p, mode)
            return True
        if cmd in ('chown', 'chgrp'):
            nonflags = [a for a in args if not a.startswith('-')]
            if len(nonflags) < 2:
                return False
            spec = nonflags[0]
            for a in nonflags[1:]:
                p = safe_abs(a)
                if p:
                    chown_path(spec, p, cmd)
            return True
        if cmd == 'ln':
            nonflags = [a for a in args if not a.startswith('-')]
            if len(nonflags) < 2:
                return False
            target = safe_abs(nonflags[-1])
            if not target:
                return False
            src = safe_abs(nonflags[-2])
            if not src:
                src = unquote(nonflags[-2])
            if not src:
                return False
            hard = not ('-s' in args or '--symbolic' in args)
            return make_symlink(src, target, hard)
        if cmd in ('echo', 'printf'):
            i = 0
            content = []
            newline = True
            while i != len(args) and args[i] not in ('>', '>>'):
                a = args[i]
                if cmd == 'echo' and a == '-n':
                    newline = False
                elif cmd == 'echo' and a.startswith('-') and len(a) > 1 and 'n' in a:
                    newline = False
                elif cmd == 'printf' and a.startswith('%'):
                    pass
                else:
                    content.append(a)
                i += 1
            if i != len(args) and args[i] in ('>', '>>') and idx_ok(args, i + 1):
                op = args[i]
                path = safe_abs(args[i + 1])
                if path:
                    c = ' '.join(content)
                    if newline and not c.endswith('\n'):
                        c += '\n'
                    return write_text(path, c, 'w' if op == '>' else 'append')
            return True
        if cmd == 'tar':
            archive = None
            cwd = None
            dirs = []
            i = 0
            while i != len(args):
                a = args[i]
                if a in ('-C', '--directory'):
                    if idx_ok(args, i + 1):
                        cwd = unquote(args[i + 1])
                        i += 2
                        continue
                elif a.startswith('--directory='):
                    cwd = a.split('=', 1)[1]
                    i += 1
                    continue
                elif a in ('--file',):
                    if idx_ok(args, i + 1):
                        archive = unquote(args[i + 1])
                        i += 2
                        continue
                elif a.startswith('--file='):
                    archive = a.split('=', 1)[1]
                    i += 1
                    continue
                elif a.startswith('-') and len(a) > 1 and any(c in a for c in 'czfvx'):
                    j = i + 1
                    if 'f' in a and idx_ok(args, j) and not args[j].startswith('-'):
                        archive = unquote(args[j])
                        j += 1
                    if any(c in a for c in 'cx'):
                        while j != len(args) and not args[j].startswith('-'):
                            dirs.append(unquote(args[j]))
                            j += 1
                    i = j
                    continue
                elif a.startswith('-'):
                    i += 1
                    continue
                else:
                    dirs.append(unquote(a))
                    i += 1
            if archive:
                arch = safe_abs(archive)
                if arch:
                    ensure_parent(arch)
                    if cwd:
                        cwd_safe = safe_abs(cwd)
                        if cwd_safe and dirs:
                            subprocess.run(['tar', '-czf', arch] + dirs, cwd=cwd_safe, check=False, timeout=120)
                            set_last(arch)
                            return True
                    else:
                        dlist = [safe_abs(d) for d in dirs]
                        dlist = [d for d in dlist if d]
                        if dlist:
                            subprocess.run(['tar', '-czf', arch] + dlist, check=False, timeout=120)
                            set_last(arch)
                            return True
            return False
        if cmd in ('gzip', 'gunzip'):
            nonflags = [a for a in args if not a.startswith('-')]
            if not nonflags:
                return False
            for a in nonflags:
                p = safe_abs(a)
                if p:
                    subprocess.run([cmd, p], check=False, timeout=60)
                    set_last(p)
            return True
        if cmd == 'git':
            if len(args) >= 1 and args[0] == 'clone':
                url = None
                for a in args:
                    if '://' in a or a.endswith('.git') or a.startswith('git@'):
                        url = a
                        break
                if url:
                    idx = args.index(url)
                    dst = args[idx + 1] if idx_ok(args, idx + 1) else None
                    return git_clone(url, dst)
            return False
        if cmd == 'apt-get':
            if args and args[0] == 'install':
                pkgs = [a for a in args[1:] if not a.startswith('-')]
                return run_apt(pkgs)
            return False
        if cmd in SAFE_REDIRECT_COMMANDS:
            redir = None
            for i, a in enumerate(args):
                if a in ('>', '>>'):
                    redir = i
                    break
            if redir is not None and idx_ok(args, redir + 1):
                out = safe_abs(args[redir + 1])
                if out:
                    ensure_parent(out)
                    mode = 'ab' if args[redir] == '>>' else 'wb'
                    try:
                        with open(out, mode) as fout:
                            subprocess.run([parts[0]] + args[:redir], stdout=fout, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, check=False, timeout=60)
                        set_last(out)
                        return True
                    except Exception:
                        return False
        return True
    except Exception:
        return False

def quoted_strings(s):
    return [unquote(x) for x in re.findall(r'"[^"]*"|\'[^\']*\'|`[^`]+`', s or '')]

def clean_content(c):
    c = (c or '').strip()
    c = unquote(c)
    c = c.strip('`"\'').strip()
    c = re.sub(r'\s*[.!?]+\s*$', '', c).strip()
    if not c:
        return None
    if NO_CONTENT.match(c):
        return None
    return c

def extract_from_before(before):
    if not before:
        return None
    b = before.strip()
    b = re.sub(r'^(?:please\s+|kindly\s+)?', '', b, flags=re.I)
    b = re.sub(r'^(?:write|put|echo|append|prepend|add|save|store|insert|set|update|create|make|new|change|replace|include)\s+', '', b, flags=re.I)
    b = re.sub(r'^(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+)+', '', b, flags=re.I)
    b = re.sub(r'^(?:contents?|text|data|message|line|value|following|note|placeholder)\s+(?:to\s+be\s+)?(?:added|written|stored|saved|placed|inserted|included|is|are)?\s*', '', b, flags=re.I)
    q = re.search(r'"[^"]*"|\'[^\']*\'|`[^`]+`', b)
    if q:
        c = clean_content(unquote(q.group(0)))
        if c:
            return c
    m = re.search(r':\s*(.+)$', b)
    if m:
        c = clean_content(m.group(1))
        if c:
            return c
    return clean_content(b)

def get_content(text, path=None, before=None):
    s = text
    if path:
        pu = unquote(path)
        s = re.sub(r'\b(?:to|into|in|inside|under|within)\s+(?:(?:the|a|an)\s+)?(?:file|directory|folder|dir|subfolder|subdirectory|location|place)?\s*' + re.escape(pu) + r'\s*[.,;]?\s*$', '', s, flags=re.I)
        s = re.sub(r'\b' + re.escape(pu) + r'\b', '', s)
        s = re.sub(r"""["']""" + re.escape(pu) + r"""["']""", '', s)
        s = re.sub('`' + re.escape(pu) + '`', '', s)
    for q in quoted_strings(s):
        c = clean_content(q)
        if c:
            return c
    c = extract_from_before(before)
    if c:
        return c
    m = re.search(r':\s*(?P<c>.+)$', s)
    if m:
        c = clean_content(m.group('c'))
        if c:
            return c
    m = re.search(r"\b(?:with\s+)?(?:the\s+)?(?:contents?|text|data|message|line|value|following)\s+(?:of\s+)?(?P<c>.+)$", s, re.I)
    if m:
        c = clean_content(m.group('c'))
        if c:
            return c
    return None

def last_path_like(text):
    cands = re.findall(PATH_TOKEN, text)
    for c in reversed(cands):
        c = unquote(c)
        if not c or c.startswith('-'):
            continue
        if c.lower() in COMMON:
            continue
        if '/' in c:
            return c
        if re.search(r'\.[A-Za-z0-9]{1,10}$', c):
            return c
    for c in reversed(cands):
        c = unquote(c)
        if not c or c.startswith('-'):
            continue
        if c.lower() in COMMON:
            continue
        if re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+', c) and re.search(r'[A-Za-z0-9]', c):
            return c
    return None

TO_DEST_RE = re.compile(r"\b(?:to|into)\s+(?:(?:the|a|an)\s+)?(?:file|directory|folder|dir|subfolder|subdirectory|location|place)?\s*(?P<path>"+PATH_TOKEN+r")\s*(?:,?\s*(?:in|inside|under|within)\s+(?:(?:the|a|an)\s+)?(?:directory|folder|dir|subfolder|subdirectory)?\s*(?P<dir>"+PATH_TOKEN+r"))?\s*[.,;]?\s*$", re.I)
AT_DEST_RE = re.compile(r"\bat\s+(?:(?:the|a|an)\s+)?(?:file|directory|folder|dir|subfolder|subdirectory|location|place)?\s*(?P<path>"+PATH_TOKEN+r")\s*(?:,?\s*(?:in|inside|under|within)\s+(?:(?:the|a|an)\s+)?(?:directory|folder|dir|subfolder|subdirectory)?\s*(?P<dir>"+PATH_TOKEN+r"))?\s*[.,;]?\s*$", re.I)
NAMED_RE = re.compile(r"\b(?:named|called|titled|with\s+the\s+name|with\s+name|name)\s+(?P<path>"+PATH_TOKEN+r")", re.I)
FILE_RE = re.compile(r"\b(?:file|files|folder|folders|directory|directories|dir|dirs|document|note|script|archive|image|log|config|conf|data|text\s+file)[:\s]+(?P<path>"+PATH_TOKEN+r")", re.I)
AS_DEST_RE = re.compile(r"\bas\s+(?P<path>"+PATH_TOKEN+r")\s*[.,;]?\s*$", re.I)
IN_DEST_RE = re.compile(r"\b(?:in|inside|under|within)\s+(?:(?:the|a|an)\s+)?(?:directory|folder|dir|subfolder|subdirectory)?\s*(?P<path>"+PATH_TOKEN+r")\s*[.,;]?\s*$", re.I)
TRAILING_DIR_RE = re.compile(r"\s[, ]*(?:in|inside|under|within)\s+(?:(?:the|a|an)\s+)?(?:directory|folder|dir|subfolder|subdirectory)?\s*(?P<dir>"+PATH_TOKEN+r")\s*[.,;]?\s*$", re.I)

def maybe_join_trailing_dir(p, text):
    if not p:
        return p
    m = TRAILING_DIR_RE.search(text)
    if m:
        d = unquote(m.group('dir'))
        if d and d.lower() not in COMMON:
            if not os.path.isabs(p) and not p.startswith(d + os.sep) and os.path.basename(p) != d:
                return os.path.join(d, p)
    return p

def find_destination_info(text):
    m = TO_DEST_RE.search(text)
    if m:
        p = unquote(m.group('path'))
        d = unquote(m.group('dir')) if m.group('dir') else None
        if d and p and not os.path.isabs(p) and not p.startswith(d + os.sep):
            p = os.path.join(d, p)
        if p and p.lower() in COMMON:
            p = None
        return p, text[:m.start()].strip()
    m = AT_DEST_RE.search(text)
    if m:
        p = unquote(m.group('path'))
        d = unquote(m.group('dir')) if m.group('dir') else None
        if d and p and not os.path.isabs(p) and not p.startswith(d + os.sep):
            p = os.path.join(d, p)
        if p and p.lower() in COMMON:
            p = None
        return p, text[:m.start()].strip()
    m = NAMED_RE.search(text)
    if m:
        p = unquote(m.group('path'))
        p = maybe_join_trailing_dir(p, text)
        if p and p.lower() in COMMON:
            p = None
        return p, None
    m = FILE_RE.search(text)
    if m:
        p = unquote(m.group('path'))
        p = maybe_join_trailing_dir(p, text)
        if p and p.lower() in COMMON:
            p = None
        return p, None
    m = AS_DEST_RE.search(text)
    if m:
        p = unquote(m.group('path'))
        return p, None
    m = IN_DEST_RE.search(text)
    if m:
        p = unquote(m.group('path'))
        if p and p.lower() not in COMMON:
            return p, None
    return last_path_like(text), None

def get_source(text, dest=None):
    m = re.search(r"\bfrom\s+(?:(?:the|a|an)\s+)?(?:file|directory|folder|dir)?\s*(?P<p>"+PATH_TOKEN+r")", text, re.I)
    if m:
        p = unquote(m.group('p'))
        if p.lower() not in COMMON:
            return p
    m = re.search(r"\b(?:of|for)\s+(?:(?:the|a|an)\s+)?(?:file|directory|folder|dir)?\s*(?P<p>"+PATH_TOKEN+r")\s*[.,;]?\s*$", text, re.I)
    if m:
        p = unquote(m.group('p'))
        if p.lower() not in COMMON:
            return p
    m = re.search(r"\b(?:named|called|titled|name)\s+(?P<p>"+PATH_TOKEN+r")", text, re.I)
    if m:
        p = unquote(m.group('p'))
        if p.lower() not in COMMON:
            return p
    m = re.search(r"\b(?:file|files|folder|folders|directory|directories|dir|dirs|document|note|script|archive|image|log|config|conf|data|text\s+file)[:\s]+(?P<p>"+PATH_TOKEN+r")", text, re.I)
    if m:
        p = unquote(m.group('p'))
        if p.lower() not in COMMON:
            return p
    if dest:
        t = text
        du = unquote(dest)

def process(task):
    if not task:
        return False
    if handle_command_line(task):
        return True
    if re.match(r'^(?:read|cat|view|open|display|show|inspect|examine)\b', task, re.I):
        if not re.search(r'\b(?:create|make|new|write|put|echo|append|prepend|add|save|store|insert|set|update|change|replace|delete|remove|move|rename|copy|backup|chmod|permission|owner|group|install|clone|symlink|link|clear|empty|truncate|run|execute|invoke|call|start)\b', task, re.I):
            return True
    if re.search(r'\b(?:symbolic\s+link|symlink|soft\s+link|hard\s+link|hardlink|link)(?!\.)', task, re.I):
        if handle_link(task):
            return True
        if re.search(r'\b(?:symbolic\s+link|symlink|soft\s+link|hard\s+link|hardlink)\b', task, re.I):
            return False
    if re.search(r'\b(?:directories?|folders?|dirs?)(?!\.)', task, re.I):
        if re.search(r'\b(?:create|make|new|add|mkdir|establish)\b', task, re.I):
            return handle_make_dir(task)
        if re.search(r'\b(?:delete|remove|rm|erase|rmdir|purge|trash)\b', task, re.I) and handle_delete(task):
            return True
        if re.search(r'\b(?:move|rename|mv|change)\b', task, re.I):
            return handle_move(task)
        if re.search(r'\b(?:copy|cp|duplicate|backup)\b', task, re.I) and handle_copy(task):
            return True
    if re.search(r'\b(?:clear|empty|truncate|reset|zero|wipe)(?!\.)', task, re.I) or re.search(r'\b(?:remove|delete|erase)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:content|contents|data|text|lines?|entries?|records?)\b', task, re.I):
        if handle_clear(task):
            return True
    if re.search(r'\b(?:delete|remove|rm|unlink|erase|purge|trash)(?!\.)', task, re.I):
        if handle_delete(task):
            return True
    if re.search(r'\bchmod\b', task, re.I) or re.search(r'\bpermissions?\b.*(?:to\s+[0-7]{3,4}|should\s+be\s+[0-7]{3,4})', task, re.I) or re.search(r'\bmake\s+(?:it\s+|the\s+)?(?:executable|writable|readable|writabe?)\b', task, re.I) or re.search(r'\b(?:add|remove)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:execute|write|read)\s+permission', task, re.I):
        return handle_permissions(task)
    if re.search(r'\b(?:chown|chgrp)\b', task, re.I) or re.search(r'\b(?:owner|group)s?\b.*\bto\s+\S+', task, re.I):
        return handle_ownership(task)
    if re.search(r'\b(?:move|rename|mv|shift|transfer)(?!\.)', task, re.I) or re.search(r'\bchange\s+the\s+name\b', task, re.I):
        return handle_move(task)
    if re.search(r'\b(?:copy|cp|duplicate|backup)(?!\.)', task, re.I):
        if handle_copy(task):
            return True
    if re.match(r'^(?:install|apt\s+install|apt-get\s+install)\b', task, re.I):
        return handle_install(task)
    if re.search(r'\b(?:clone|clones?|repository|repo|git\s+repo)\b', task, re.I) and re.search(URL_PATTERN, task):
        return handle_clone(task)
    if re.search(r'\b(?:write|put|echo|append|prepend|add|save|store|insert|set|update|change|replace|contains?|content|contents)\b', task, re.I):
        if handle_write(task):
            return True
    if re.search(r'\b(?:create|make|new|touch|generate|establish)\b', task, re.I):
        if handle_create_file(task):
            return True
    if re.match(r'^(?:run|execute|invoke|call|start|launch)\b', task, re.I):
        return handle_run_command(task)
    return False

checkbox_re = re.compile(r'^(\s*(?:[-*+]\s+)?)(\[\s*)([ xX☐✓?]*)(\s*\])')

def is_checked(line):
    m = checkbox_re.match(line)
    return bool(m) and m.group(3).strip().lower() in ('x', '✓')

def check_line(line):
    return checkbox_re.sub(lambda m: m.group(1) + m.group(2) + 'x' + m.group(4), line, count=1)

def clean_task(line):
    s = line.strip()
    for _ in range(3):
        s2 = re.sub(r'^\[\s*[ xX☐✓?]*\s*\]\s*', '', s)
        s2 = re.sub(r'^[-*+]\s+', '', s2)
        s2 = re.sub(r'^\d+[.)]\s*', '', s2)
        if s2 == s:
            break
        s = s2
    return s.strip()

URL_PATTERN = r'(?:[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9+.\-]*://\S+|git@[^\s:]+:\S+|(?:github\.com|gitlab\.com|bitbucket\.org)/[^\s]+)'
COMMON = {'a','an','the','to','in','inside','under','within','of','for','named','called','titled','name','create','make','new','add','append','prepend','write','put','echo','save','store','insert','set','update','change','replace','delete','remove','rm','unlink','erase','purge','trash','move','rename','mv','copy','cp','duplicate','backup','as','at','from','with','and','or','on','by','is','are','be','should','need','needs','please','kindly','task','tasks','complete','this','that','these','those','it','its','empty','existing','all','only','just','very','not','no','yes','if','then','when','while','after','before','run','execute','invoke','call','start','launch','command','commands','install','package','packages','program','programs','software','clone','clones','repository','repo','project','link','links','symbolic','soft','hard','permission','permissions','owner','owners','group','groups','mode'}
NO_CONTENT = re.compile(r'^(?:(?:the|a|an)\s+)?(?:(?:file|text|data|message|line|value|content|contents)\s+)?(?:contents?|text|data|message|line|value|placeholder|nothing|empty|file|document|note|following)$', re.I)
LAST_PATH = None

def unquote(s):
    s = (s or '').strip()
    if len(s) >= 2 and s[0] == s[-1] and s[0] in ('"', "'", '`'):
        return s[1:-1]
    return s

def safe_abs(p):
    p = unquote(p)
    if not p:
        return None
    if p.startswith('~'):
        p = os.path.expanduser(p)
    if not p.startswith('/'):
        p = os.path.join(WS, p)
    rp = os.path.realpath(p)
    for pref in ALLOW_PREFIXES:
        rpref = os.path.realpath(pref)
        if rp == rpref or rp.startswith(rpref + os.sep):
            return p
    return None

def ensure_parent(p):
    parent = os.path.dirname(p)
    if parent:
        os.makedirs(parent, exist_ok=True)

def set_last(p):
    global LAST_PATH
    LAST_PATH = p

def idx_ok(seq, i):
    return i >= 0 and i != len(seq)

def write_text(p, content, mode='w'):
    p = safe_abs(p)
    if not p or not content:
        return False
    ensure_parent(p)
    if os.path.isdir(p):
        return False
    if mode == 'prepend':
        old = ''
        if os.path.exists(p):
            with open(p, 'r', errors='replace') as f:
                old = f.read()
        with open(p, 'w') as f:
            f.write(content)
            if not content.endswith('\n'):
                f.write('\n')
            f.write(old)
    elif mode == 'append':
        with open(p, 'a') as f:
            f.write(content)
            if not content.endswith('\n'):
                f.write('\n')
    else:
        with open(p, 'w') as f:
            f.write(content)
            if not content.endswith('\n'):
                f.write('\n')
    set_last(p)
    return True

def touch_file(p):
    p = safe_abs(p)
    if not p:
        return False
    if os.path.isdir(p):
        return False
    ensure_parent(p)
    if not os.path.exists(p):
        with open(p, 'a'):
            pass
    set_last(p)
    return True

def delete_path(p):
    p = safe_abs(p)
    if not p:
        return False
    rp = os.path.realpath(p)
    for pref in ALLOW_PREFIXES:
        if rp == os.path.realpath(pref):
            raise ValueError('protected path')
    todo_rp = os.path.realpath(TODO)
    if rp == todo_rp or todo_rp.startswith(rp + os.sep):
        raise ValueError('protected path')
    if os.path.islink(p) or os.path.isfile(p):
        os.remove(p)
        set_last(p)
        return True
    if os.path.isdir(p):
        shutil.rmtree(p)
        set_last(p)
        return True
    return False

def move_path(src, dst):
    src = safe_abs(src)
    dst = safe_abs(dst)
    if not src or not dst:
        return False
    if not os.path.exists(src):
        return False
    if src == dst:
        return True
    ensure_parent(dst)
    shutil.move(src, dst)
    set_last(dst)
    return True

def copy_path(src, dst):
    src = safe_abs(src)
    dst = safe_abs(dst)
    if not src or not dst:
        return False
    if not os.path.exists(src):
        return False
    ensure_parent(dst)
    if os.path.isdir(src):
        if os.path.exists(dst):
            shutil.copytree(src, dst, dirs_exist_ok=True)
        else:
            shutil.copytree(src, dst)
    else:
        shutil.copy2(src, dst)
    set_last(dst)
    return True

def make_symlink(src, target, hard=False):
    target = safe_abs(target)
    if not target:
        return False
    ensure_parent(target)
    if os.path.lexists(target):
        os.remove(target)
    if hard:
        if not os.path.exists(src):
            return False
        os.link(src, target)
    else:
        os.symlink(src, target)
    set_last(target)
    return True

def chmod_path(p, mode):
    p = safe_abs(p)
    if not p or not mode:
        return False
    if not os.path.exists(p):
        return False
    m = mode.strip()
    if m and all(ch in '01234567' for ch in m):
        try:
            os.chmod(p, int(m, 8))
        except Exception:
            return False
    else:
        try:
            r = subprocess.run(['chmod', m, p], check=False, timeout=30)
            if r.returncode != 0:
                return False
        except Exception:
            return False
    set_last(p)
    return True

def chown_path(spec, p, cmd='chown'):
    p = safe_abs(p)
    if not p or not spec:
        return False
    if not os.path.exists(p):
        return False
    try:
        r = subprocess.run([cmd, spec, p], check=False, timeout=30)
        if r.returncode != 0:
            return False
    except Exception:
        return False
    set_last(p)
    return True

def run_apt(pkgs):
    if not pkgs:
        return False
    cmd = ['apt-get', 'install', '-y']
    try:
        if os.geteuid() != 0 and shutil.which('sudo'):
            cmd = ['sudo', '-n'] + cmd
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        r = subprocess.run(cmd + list(pkgs), check=False, timeout=180, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        return r.returncode == 0
    except Exception:
        return False

def git_clone(url, dst=None):
    if not url:
        return False
    if dst is None:
        base = url.rstrip('/').split('/')[-1]
        if base.endswith('.git'):
            base = base[:-4]
        if not base:
            base = 'repo'
        dst = base
    dst = safe_abs(dst)
    if not dst:
        return False
    ensure_parent(dst)
    if os.path.exists(dst):
        return True
    try:
        r = subprocess.run(['git', 'clone', '--depth', '1', url, dst], check=False, timeout=120, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        return r.returncode == 0
    except Exception:
        return False

def handle_command_line(text):
    try:
        parts = shlex.split(text)
    except ValueError:
        return False
    if not parts:
        return False
    cmd = os.path.basename(parts[0])
    if cmd not in ALLOWED_COMMANDS:
        return False
    args = parts[1:]
    try:
        if cmd == 'mkdir':
            paths = []
            for a in args:
                if a.startswith('-'):
                    continue
                p = safe_abs(a)
                if p:
                    paths.append(p)
            if not paths:
                return False
            for p in paths:
                os.makedirs(p, exist_ok=True)
                set_last(p)
            return True
        if cmd == 'touch':
            paths = []
            for a in args:
                if a.startswith('-'):
                    continue
                p = safe_abs(a)
                if p:
                    paths.append(p)
            if not paths:
                return False
            for p in paths:
                touch_file(p)
            return True
        if cmd in ('cp', 'mv'):
            nonflags = [a for a in args if not a.startswith('-')]
            if len(nonflags) < 2:
                return False
            src = safe_abs(nonflags[-2])
            dst = safe_abs(nonflags[-1])
            if not src or not dst:
                return False
            if cmd == 'cp':
                return copy_path(src, dst)
            return move_path(src, dst)
        if cmd in ('rm', 'rmdir'):
            nonflags = [a for a in args if not a.startswith('-')]
            if not nonflags:
                return False
            for a in nonflags:
                p = safe_abs(a)
                if not p:
                    continue
                if cmd == 'rmdir' and not os.path.isdir(p):
                    continue
                delete_path(p)
            return True
        if cmd == 'chmod':
            nonflags = []
            for a in args:
                if a.startswith('-'):
                    continue
                nonflags.append(a)
            if len(nonflags) < 2:
                return False
            mode = nonflags[0]
            for a in nonflags[1:]:
                p = safe_abs(a)
                if p:
                    chmod_path(p, mode)
            return True
        if cmd in ('chown', 'chgrp'):
            nonflags = [a for a in args if not a.startswith('-')]
            if len(nonflags) < 2:
                return False
            spec = nonflags[0]
            for a in nonflags[1:]:
                p = safe_abs(a)
                if p:
                    chown_path(spec, p, cmd)
            return True
        if cmd == 'ln':
            nonflags = [a for a in args if not a.startswith('-')]
            if len(nonflags) < 2:
                return False
            target = safe_abs(nonflags[-1])
            if not target:
                return False
            src = safe_abs(nonflags[-2])
            if not src:
                src = unquote(nonflags[-2])
            if not src:
                return False
            hard = not ('-s' in args or '--symbolic' in args)
            return make_symlink(src, target, hard)
        if cmd in ('echo', 'printf'):
            i = 0
            content = []
            newline = True
            while i != len(args) and args[i] not in ('>', '>>'):
                a = args[i]
                if cmd == 'echo' and a == '-n':
                    newline = False
                elif cmd == 'echo' and a.startswith('-') and len(a) > 1 and 'n' in a:
                    newline = False
                elif cmd == 'printf' and a.startswith('%'):
                    pass
                else:
                    content.append(a)
                i += 1
            if i != len(args) and args[i] in ('>', '>>') and idx_ok(args, i + 1):
                op = args[i]
                path = safe_abs(args[i + 1])
                if path:
                    c = ' '.join(content)
                    if newline and not c.endswith('\n'):
                        c += '\n'
                    return write_text(path, c, 'w' if op == '>' else 'append')
            return True
        if cmd == 'tar':
            archive = None
            cwd = None
            dirs = []
            i = 0
            while i != len(args):
                a = args[i]
                if a in ('-C', '--directory'):
                    if idx_ok(args, i + 1):
                        cwd = unquote(args[i + 1])
                        i += 2
                        continue
                elif a.startswith('--directory='):
                    cwd = a.split('=', 1)[1]
                    i += 1
                    continue
                elif a in ('--file',):
                    if idx_ok(args, i + 1):
                        archive = unquote(args[i + 1])
                        i += 2
                        continue
                elif a.startswith('--file='):
                    archive = a.split('=', 1)[1]
                    i += 1
                    continue
                elif a.startswith('-') and len(a) > 1 and any(c in a for c in 'czfvx'):
                    j = i + 1
                    if 'f' in a and idx_ok(args, j) and not args[j].startswith('-'):
                        archive = unquote(args[j])
                        j += 1
                    if any(c in a for c in 'cx'):
                        while j != len(args) and not args[j].startswith('-'):
                            dirs.append(unquote(args[j]))
                            j += 1
                    i = j
                    continue
                elif a.startswith('-'):
                    i += 1
                    continue
                else:
                    dirs.append(unquote(a))
                    i += 1
            if archive:
                arch = safe_abs(archive)
                if arch:
                    ensure_parent(arch)
                    if cwd:
                        cwd_safe = safe_abs(cwd)
                        if cwd_safe and dirs:
                            subprocess.run(['tar', '-czf', arch] + dirs, cwd=cwd_safe, check=False, timeout=120)
                            set_last(arch)
                            return True
                    else:
                        dlist = [safe_abs(d) for d in dirs]
                        dlist = [d for d in dlist if d]
                        if dlist:
                            subprocess.run(['tar', '-czf', arch] + dlist, check=False, timeout=120)
                            set_last(arch)
                            return True
            return False
        if cmd in ('gzip', 'gunzip'):
            nonflags = [a for a in args if not a.startswith('-')]
            if not nonflags:
                return False
            for a in nonflags:
                p = safe_abs(a)
                if p:
                    subprocess.run([cmd, p], check=False, timeout=60)
                    set_last(p)
            return True
        if cmd == 'git':
            if len(args) >= 1 and args[0] == 'clone':
                url = None
                for a in args:
                    if '://' in a or a.endswith('.git') or a.startswith('git@'):
                        url = a
                        break
                if url:
                    idx = args.index(url)
                    dst = args[idx + 1] if idx_ok(args, idx + 1) else None
                    return git_clone(url, dst)
            return False
        if cmd == 'apt-get':
            if args and args[0] == 'install':
                pkgs = [a for a in args[1:] if not a.startswith('-')]
                return run_apt(pkgs)
            return False
        if cmd in SAFE_REDIRECT_COMMANDS:
            redir = None
            for i, a in enumerate(args):
                if a in ('>', '>>'):
                    redir = i
                    break
            if redir is not None and idx_ok(args, redir + 1):
                out = safe_abs(args[redir + 1])
                if out:
                    ensure_parent(out)
                    mode = 'ab' if args[redir] == '>>' else 'wb'
                    try:
                        with open(out, mode) as fout:
                            subprocess.run([parts[0]] + args[:redir], stdout=fout, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, check=False, timeout=60)
                        set_last(out)
                        return True
                    except Exception:
                        return False
        return True
    except Exception:
        return False

def quoted_strings(s):
    return [unquote(x) for x in re.findall(r'"[^"]*"|\'[^\']*\'|`[^`]+`', s or '')]

def clean_content(c):
    c = (c or '').strip()
    c = unquote(c)
    c = c.strip('`"\'').strip()
    c = re.sub(r'\s*[.!?]+\s*$', '', c).strip()
    if not c:
        return None
    if NO_CONTENT.match(c):
        return None
    return c

def extract_from_before(before):
    if not before:
        return None
    b = before.strip()
    b = re.sub(r'^(?:please\s+|kindly\s+)?', '', b, flags=re.I)
    b = re.sub(r'^(?:write|put|echo|append|prepend|add|save|store|insert|set|update|create|make|new|change|replace|include)\s+', '', b, flags=re.I)
    b = re.sub(r'^(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+)+', '', b, flags=re.I)
    b = re.sub(r'^(?:contents?|text|data|message|line|value|following|note|placeholder)\s+(?:to\s+be\s+)?(?:added|written|stored|saved|placed|inserted|included|is|are)?\s*', '', b, flags=re.I)
    q = re.search(r'"[^"]*"|\'[^\']*\'|`[^`]+`', b)
    if q:
        c = clean_content(unquote(q.group(0)))
        if c:
            return c
    m = re.search(r':\s*(.+)$', b)
    if m:
        c = clean_content(m.group(1))
        if c:
            return c
    return clean_content(b)

def get_content(text, path=None, before=None):
    s = text
    if path:
        pu = unquote(path)
        s = re.sub(r'\b(?:to|into|in|inside|under|within)\s+(?:(?:the|a|an)\s+)?(?:file|directory|folder|dir|subfolder|subdirectory|location|place)?\s*' + re.escape(pu) + r'\s*[.,;]?\s*$', '', s, flags=re.I)
        s = re.sub(r'\b' + re.escape(pu) + r'\b', '', s)
        s = re.sub(r"""["']""" + re.escape(pu) + r"""["']""", '', s)
        s = re.sub('`' + re.escape(pu) + '`', '', s)
    for q in quoted_strings(s):
        c = clean_content(q)
        if c:
            return c
    c = extract_from_before(before)
    if c:
        return c
    m = re.search(r':\s*(?P<c>.+)$', s)
    if m:
        c = clean_content(m.group('c'))
        if c:
            return c
    m = re.search(r"\b(?:with\s+)?(?:the\s+)?(?:contents?|text|data|message|line|value|following)\s+(?:of\s+)?(?P<c>.+)$", s, re.I)
    if m:
        c = clean_content(m.group('c'))
        if c:
            return c
    return None

def last_path_like(text):
    cands = re.findall(PATH_TOKEN, text)
    for c in reversed(cands):
        c = unquote(c)
        if not c or c.startswith('-'):
            continue
        if c.lower() in COMMON:
            continue
        if '/' in c:
            return c
        if re.search(r'\.[A-Za-z0-9]{1,10}$', c):
            return c
    for c in reversed(cands):
        c = unquote(c)
        if not c or c.startswith('-'):
            continue
        if c.lower() in COMMON:
            continue
        if re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+', c) and re.search(r'[A-Za-z0-9]', c):
            return c
    return None

TO_DEST_RE = re.compile(r"\b(?:to|into)\s+(?:(?:the|a|an)\s+)?(?:file|directory|folder|dir|subfolder|subdirectory|location|place)?\s*(?P<path>"+PATH_TOKEN+r")\s*(?:,?\s*(?:in|inside|under|within)\s+(?:(?:the|a|an)\s+)?(?:directory|folder|dir|subfolder|subdirectory)?\s*(?P<dir>"+PATH_TOKEN+r"))?\s*[.,;]?\s*$", re.I)
AT_DEST_RE = re.compile(r"\bat\s+(?:(?:the|a|an)\s+)?(?:file|directory|folder|dir|subfolder|subdirectory|location|place)?\s*(?P<path>"+PATH_TOKEN+r")\s*(?:,?\s*(?:in|inside|under|within)\s+(?:(?:the|a|an)\s+)?(?:directory|folder|dir|subfolder|subdirectory)?\s*(?P<dir>"+PATH_TOKEN+r"))?\s*[.,;]?\s*$", re.I)
NAMED_RE = re.compile(r"\b(?:named|called|titled|with\s+the\s+name|with\s+name|name)\s+(?P<path>"+PATH_TOKEN+r")", re.I)
FILE_RE = re.compile(r"\b(?:file|files|folder|folders|directory|directories|dir|dirs|document|note|script|archive|image|log|config|conf|data|text\s+file)[:\s]+(?P<path>"+PATH_TOKEN+r")", re.I)
AS_DEST_RE = re.compile(r"\bas\s+(?P<path>"+PATH_TOKEN+r")\s*[.,;]?\s*$", re.I)
IN_DEST_RE = re.compile(r"\b(?:in|inside|under|within)\s+(?:(?:the|a|an)\s+)?(?:directory|folder|dir|subfolder|subdirectory)?\s*(?P<path>"+PATH_TOKEN+r")\s*[.,;]?\s*$", re.I)
TRAILING_DIR_RE = re.compile(r"\s[, ]*(?:in|inside|under|within)\s+(?:(?:the|a|an)\s+)?(?:directory|folder|dir|subfolder|subdirectory)?\s*(?P<dir>"+PATH_TOKEN+r")\s*[.,;]?\s*$", re.I)

def maybe_join_trailing_dir(p, text):
    if not p:
        return p
    m = TRAILING_DIR_RE.search(text)
    if m:
        d = unquote(m.group('dir'))
        if d and d.lower() not in COMMON:
            if not os.path.isabs(p) and not p.startswith(d + os.sep) and os.path.basename(p) != d:
                return os.path.join(d, p)
    return p

def find_destination_info(text):
    m = TO_DEST_RE.search(text)
    if m:
        p = unquote(m.group('path'))
        d = unquote(m.group('dir')) if m.group('dir') else None
        if d and p and not os.path.isabs(p) and not p.startswith(d + os.sep):
            p = os.path.join(d, p)
        if p and p.lower() in COMMON:
            p = None
        return p, text[:m.start()].strip()
    m = AT_DEST_RE.search(text)
    if m:
        p = unquote(m.group('path'))
        d = unquote(m.group('dir')) if m.group('dir') else None
        if d and p and not os.path.isabs(p) and not p.startswith(d + os.sep):
            p = os.path.join(d, p)
        if p and p.lower() in COMMON:
            p = None
        return p, text[:m.start()].strip()
    m = NAMED_RE.search(text)
    if m:
        p = unquote(m.group('path'))
        p = maybe_join_trailing_dir(p, text)
        if p and p.lower() in COMMON:
            p = None
        return p, None
    m = FILE_RE.search(text)
    if m:
        p = unquote(m.group('path'))
        p = maybe_join_trailing_dir(p, text)
        if p and p.lower() in COMMON:
            p = None
        return p, None
    m = AS_DEST_RE.search(text)
    if m:
        p = unquote(m.group('path'))
        return p, None
    m = IN_DEST_RE.search(text)
    if m:
        p = unquote(m.group('path'))
        if p and p.lower() not in COMMON:
            return p, None
    return last_path_like(text), None

def get_source(text, dest=None):
    m = re.search(r"\bfrom\s+(?:(?:the|a|an)\s+)?(?:file|directory|folder|dir)?\s*(?P<p>"+PATH_TOKEN+r")", text, re.I)
    if m:
        p = unquote(m.group('p'))
        if p.lower() not in COMMON:
            return p
    m = re.search(r"\b(?:of|for)\s+(?:(?:the|a|an)\s+)?(?:file|directory|folder|dir)?\s*(?P<p>"+PATH_TOKEN+r")\s*[.,;]?\s*$", text, re.I)
    if m:
        p = unquote(m.group('p'))
        if p.lower() not in COMMON:
            return p
    m = re.search(r"\b(?:named|called|titled|name)\s+(?P<p>"+PATH_TOKEN+r")", text, re.I)
    if m:
        p = unquote(m.group('p'))
        if p.lower() not in COMMON:
            return p
    m = re.search(r"\b(?:file|files|folder|folders|directory|directories|dir|dirs|document|note|script|archive|image|log|config|conf|data|text\s+file)[:\s]+(?P<p>"+PATH_TOKEN+r")", text, re.I)
    if m:
        p = unquote(m.group('p'))
        if p.lower() not in COMMON:
            return p
    if dest:
        t = text
        du = unquote(dest)
        t = re.sub(r'\b(?:to|as|into|in|inside|under|within|named|called|titled)\s+(?:(?:the|a|an)\s+)?(?:file|directory|folder|dir|subfolder|subdirectory|location|place)?\s*' + re.escape(du) + r'\s*[.,;]?\s*$', '', t, flags=re.I)
        p = last_path_like(t)
        if p and p.lower() not in COMMON and p != dest:
            return p

def process(task):
    if not task:
        return False
    if handle_command_line(task):
        return True
    if re.match(r'^(?:read|cat|view|open|display|show|inspect|examine)\b', task, re.I):
        if not re.search(r'\b(?:create|make|new|write|put|echo|append|prepend|add|save|store|insert|set|update|change|replace|delete|remove|move|rename|copy|backup|chmod|permission|owner|group|install|clone|symlink|link|clear|empty|truncate|run|execute|invoke|call|start)\b', task, re.I):
            return True
    if re.search(r'\b(?:symbolic\s+link|symlink|soft\s+link|hard\s+link|hardlink|link)(?!\.)', task, re.I):
        if handle_link(task):
            return True
        if re.search(r'\b(?:symbolic\s+link|symlink|soft\s+link|hard\s+link|hardlink)\b', task, re.I):
            return False
    if re.search(r'\b(?:directories?|folders?|dirs?)(?!\.)', task, re.I):
        if re.search(r'\b(?:create|make|new|add|mkdir|establish)\b', task, re.I):
            return handle_make_dir(task)
        if re.search(r'\b(?:delete|remove|rm|erase|rmdir|purge|trash)\b', task, re.I) and handle_delete(task):
            return True
        if re.search(r'\b(?:move|rename|mv|change)\b', task, re.I):
            return handle_move(task)
        if re.search(r'\b(?:copy|cp|duplicate|backup)\b', task, re.I) and handle_copy(task):
            return True
    if re.search(r'\b(?:clear|empty|truncate|reset|zero|wipe)(?!\.)', task, re.I) or re.search(r'\b(?:remove|delete|erase)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:content|contents|data|text|lines?|entries?|records?)\b', task, re.I):
        if handle_clear(task):
            return True
    if re.search(r'\b(?:delete|remove|rm|unlink|erase|purge|trash)(?!\.)', task, re.I):
        if handle_delete(task):
            return True
    if re.search(r'\bchmod\b', task, re.I) or re.search(r'\bpermissions?\b.*(?:to\s+[0-7]{3,4}|should\s+be\s+[0-7]{3,4})', task, re.I) or re.search(r'\bmake\s+(?:it\s+|the\s+)?(?:executable|writable|readable|writabe?)\b', task, re.I) or re.search(r'\b(?:add|remove)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:execute|write|read)\s+permission', task, re.I):
        return handle_permissions(task)
    if re.search(r'\b(?:chown|chgrp)\b', task, re.I) or re.search(r'\b(?:owner|group)s?\b.*\bto\s+\S+', task, re.I):
        return handle_ownership(task)
    if re.search(r'\b(?:move|rename|mv|shift|transfer)(?!\.)', task, re.I) or re.search(r'\bchange\s+the\s+name\b', task, re.I):
        return handle_move(task)
    if re.search(r'\b(?:copy|cp|duplicate|backup)(?!\.)', task, re.I):
        if handle_copy(task):
            return True
    if re.match(r'^(?:install|apt\s+install|apt-get\s+install)\b', task, re.I):
        return handle_install(task)
    if re.search(r'\b(?:clone|clones?|repository|repo|git\s+repo)\b', task, re.I) and re.search(URL_PATTERN, task):
        return handle_clone(task)
    if re.search(r'\b(?:write|put|echo|append|prepend|add|save|store|insert|set|update|change|replace|contains?|content|contents)\b', task, re.I):
        if handle_write(task):
            return True
    if re.search(r'\b(?:create|make|new|touch|generate|establish)\b', task, re.I):
        if handle_create_file(task):
            return True
    if re.match(r'^(?:run|execute|invoke|call|start|launch)\b', task, re.I):
        return handle_run_command(task)
    return False

checkbox_re = re.compile(r'^(\s*(?:[-*+]\s+)?)(\[\s*)([ xX☐✓?]*)(\s*\])')

def is_checked(line):
    m = checkbox_re.match(line)
    return bool(m) and m.group(3).strip().lower() in ('x', '✓')

def check_line(line):
    return checkbox_re.sub(lambda m: m.group(1) + m.group(2) + 'x' + m.group(4), line, count=1)

def clean_task(line):
    s = line.strip()
    for _ in range(3):
        s2 = re.sub(r'^\[\s*[ xX☐✓?]*\s*\]\s*', '', s)
        s2 = re.sub(r'^[-*+]\s+', '', s2)
        s2 = re.sub(r'^\d+[.)]\s*', '', s2)
        if s2 == s:
            break
        s = s2
    return s.strip()

                return write_text(p, c, 'append')

                with open(p, 'r', errors='replace') as f:

def process(task):
    if not task:
        return False
    if handle_command_line(task):
        return True
    if re.match(r'^(?:read|cat|view|open|display|show|inspect|examine)\b', task, re.I):
        if not re.search(r'\b(?:create|make|new|write|put|echo|append|prepend|add|save|store|insert|set|update|change|replace|delete|remove|move|rename|copy|backup|chmod|permission|owner|group|install|clone|symlink|link|clear|empty|truncate|run|execute|invoke|call|start)\b', task, re.I):
            return True
    if re.search(r'\b(?:symbolic\s+link|symlink|soft\s+link|hard\s+link|hardlink|link)(?!\.)', task, re.I):
        if handle_link(task):
            return True
        if re.search(r'\b(?:symbolic\s+link|symlink|soft\s+link|hard\s+link|hardlink)\b', task, re.I):
            return False
    if re.search(r'\b(?:directories?|folders?|dirs?)(?!\.)', task, re.I):
        if re.search(r'\b(?:create|make|new|add|mkdir|establish)\b', task, re.I):
            return handle_make_dir(task)
        if re.search(r'\b(?:delete|remove|rm|erase|rmdir|purge|trash)\b', task, re.I) and handle_delete(task):
            return True
        if re.search(r'\b(?:move|rename|mv|change)\b', task, re.I):
            return handle_move(task)
        if re.search(r'\b(?:copy|cp|duplicate|backup)\b', task, re.I) and handle_copy(task):
            return True
    if re.search(r'\b(?:clear|empty|truncate|reset|zero|wipe)(?!\.)', task, re.I) or re.search(r'\b(?:remove|delete|erase)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:content|contents|data|text|lines?|entries?|records?)\b', task, re.I):
        if handle_clear(task):
            return True
    if re.search(r'\b(?:delete|remove|rm|unlink|erase|purge|trash)(?!\.)', task, re.I):
        if handle_delete(task):
            return True
    if re.search(r'\bchmod\b', task, re.I) or re.search(r'\bpermissions?\b.*(?:to\s+[0-7]{3,4}|should\s+be\s+[0-7]{3,4})', task, re.I) or re.search(r'\bmake\s+(?:it\s+|the\s+)?(?:executable|writable|readable|writabe?)\b', task, re.I) or re.search(r'\b(?:add|remove)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:execute|write|read)\s+permission', task, re.I):
        return handle_permissions(task)
    if re.search(r'\b(?:chown|chgrp)\b', task, re.I) or re.search(r'\b(?:owner|group)s?\b.*\bto\s+\S+', task, re.I):
        return handle_ownership(task)
    if re.search(r'\b(?:move|rename|mv|shift|transfer)(?!\.)', task, re.I) or re.search(r'\bchange\s+the\s+name\b', task, re.I):
        return handle_move(task)
    if re.search(r'\b(?:copy|cp|duplicate|backup)(?!\.)', task, re.I):
        if handle_copy(task):
            return True
    if re.match(r'^(?:install|apt\s+install|apt-get\s+install)\b', task, re.I):
        return handle_install(task)
    if re.search(r'\b(?:clone|clones?|repository|repo|git\s+repo)\b', task, re.I) and re.search(URL_PATTERN, task):
        return handle_clone(task)
    if re.search(r'\b(?:write|put|echo|append|prepend|add|save|store|insert|set|update|change|replace|contains?|content|contents)\b', task, re.I):
        if handle_write(task):

## Summary

**The problem:** `/workspace/process_files.sh` used word-splitting via command substitution:

```bash
for file in $(find /workspace/files -type f | sort); do
```

Because `$( ... )` splits output on all whitespace (IFS), filenames containing spaces were broken into separate loop iterations. `beta report.txt` became two files: `beta` and `report.txt`. The old `/workspace/processed.txt` confirmed this — it had 5 lines instead of 3 (`beta` / `report.txt` and `gamma` / `notes.txt` split apart).

**The fix:** Rewrote the loop to be NUL-delimited and quote-safe:

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
: > /workspace/processed.txt
while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
  basename -- "$file" >> /workspace/processed.txt
done < <(find /workspace/files -type f -print0 | sort -z)
```

- `find ... -print0` + `read -r -d ''` passes each path as a single unit regardless of spaces/newlines.
- `sort -z` keeps the sorted order on NUL records.
- `IFS=` and `-r` preserve the exact name; `basename -- "$file"` handles it safely.
- Added `set -u`/`pipefail` and kept the executable bit and the reset of `processed.txt`.
